text:
Items on the plate: two slices of toasted multigrain bread and two apricot jam portions. The tea is in a cup, not on the plate, so I left it out.

Bread: a slice weighs about 40 g, so two slices are about 80 g. At roughly 250 kcal per 100 g, that is about 200 kcal.

Jam: each portion is about 15 g, so two are about 30 g. At roughly 250 kcal per 100 g, that is about 75 kcal.

Total: about 110 g and about 275 kcal.
